source_metadata.title: Combined PD-1 and HER2 blockade for HER2-positive gastric cancer
source_metadata.source_type: primary randomized double-blind placebo-controlled phase III trial report, protocol-specified first interim analysis

extraction_metadata.scope_note: Primary interim trial report atomized with protocol-supplement context that materially affects design, eligibility, treatment, endpoints, or analysis. Site rosters, protocol administrative text, country-specific operational appendices, and bibliographies were not atomized.

atoms.canonical_statement: KEYNOTE-811 evaluated whether adding pembrolizumab to trastuzumab plus chemotherapy improves efficacy and safety as first-line treatment for unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Here we describe results of the protocol-specified first interim analysis of the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase III KEYNOTE-811 study

atoms.canonical_statement: KEYNOTE-811 is a global randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase III study.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: KEYNOTE-811 is a global randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase III study

atoms.canonical_statement: The global study was conducted at 168 medical centres across 19 countries.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: being conducted at 168 medical centres in Australia, Brazil, Chile, China, France, Germany, Guatemala, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, New Zealand, Poland, Russia, South Korea, Spain, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and the United States

atoms.canonical_statement: Participants were eligible if they were at least 18 years old with previously untreated, unresectable or metastatic, HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: eligible participants are aged 18 years or older; have previously untreated, unresectable or metastatic, histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the stomach or gastroesophageal junction that is HER2-positive

population.label: Trial eligibility
inclusion_criteria: Previously untreated unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma

atoms.canonical_statement: Eligibility also required measurable RECIST 1.1 disease, ECOG performance status 0 or 1, life expectancy over 6 months, adequate organ function, and tumor tissue for PD-L1 and MSI assessment.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: have measurable disease per RECIST, version 1.1; have ECOG performance-status score of 0 or 1; have life expectancy of more than 6 months; have adequate organ function; and have provided a tumour sample adequate for assessment of programmed death ligand 1 (PD-L1) and microsatellite instability (MSI) status

population.label: Trial eligibility
inclusion_criteria: Tumor sample adequate for PD-L1 and MSI assessment

atoms.canonical_statement: Central HER2 positivity was defined as IHC 3+ or IHC 2+ with positive ISH or FISH; ISH/FISH positivity used a HER2:CEP17 ratio at least 2.0, with copy number over 6 allowed when the ratio was below 2.0.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: HER2 positivity was defined as IHC 3+ or IHC 2+ with positive ISH or FISH, with ISH and FISH positivity defined as a ratio of ≥2.0 for the number of HER2 copies to the number of signals for CEP17; a ratio of <2.0 was considered positive if the HER2 copy number was >6

atoms.canonical_statement: Participants were randomized 1:1, stratified by geographic region, PD-L1 combined positive score, and investigator-selected chemotherapy regimen.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Participants are randomly allocated in a 1:1 ratio ... Randomization is stratified by geographic region ... PD-L1 combined positive score ... and investigator’s choice of chemotherapy

atoms.canonical_statement: The experimental arm included pembrolizumab 200 mg intravenously every 3 weeks with trastuzumab and chemotherapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: pembrolizumab at a dose of 200 mg ... administered intravenously once every 3 weeks

atoms.canonical_statement: The control arm included placebo intravenously every 3 weeks with the same trastuzumab and chemotherapy backbone.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: receive either pembrolizumab at a dose of 200 mg or placebo ... both administered intravenously once every 3 weeks

atoms.canonical_statement: Trastuzumab was given as an 8 mg/kg loading dose followed by 6 mg/kg intravenously every 3 weeks.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: trastuzumab at a dose of 6 mg per kilogram ... once every 3 weeks following an initial loading dose of 8 mg per kilogram

exposures.details: 8 mg/kg loading dose then 6 mg/kg maintenance

atoms.canonical_statement: The FP option was fluorouracil 800 mg/m2 intravenously on days 1 through 5 plus cisplatin 80 mg/m2 intravenously every 3 weeks.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 5-flurouracil (800 mg per square meter ... on days 1–5 of each 3-week cycle) and cisplatin (80 mg per square meter ... once every 3 weeks)

atoms.canonical_statement: The CAPOX option was capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 orally twice daily on days 1 through 14 plus oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2 intravenously every 3 weeks.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: capecitabine (1000 mg per square meter administered orally twice daily on days 1–14 of each 3-week cycle) and oxaliplatin (130 mg per square meter administered intravenously once every 3 weeks)

exposures.frequency: twice daily on days 1-14 of each 3-week cycle

atoms.canonical_statement: Study treatment continued for up to 35 cycles, about 2 years, or until progression, unacceptable toxicity, investigator decision, or withdrawal of consent.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: All treatment is continued for up to 35 cycles (~2 years) or until disease progression, unacceptable toxic effects, investigator decision, or participant withdrawal of consent

atoms.canonical_statement: Tumor imaging was scheduled at week 6 and every 6 weeks thereafter; RECIST 1.1 by blinded independent central review determined study endpoints.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Tumour imaging ... is scheduled for week 6 and every 6 weeks thereafter. Response is assessed according to RECIST, version 1.1, by blinded independent central review for determination of study endpoints

atoms.canonical_statement: Adverse events were collected during treatment and for 30 days after treatment, with serious adverse events collected for up to 90 days, and were graded with CTCAE version 4.03.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Adverse events and laboratory abnormalities are collected regularly during study treatment and for up to 30 days thereafter (up to 90 days for serious adverse events) ... graded according to ... CTCAE, version 4.03

atoms.canonical_statement: The dual primary endpoints were progression-free survival by blinded independent central review and overall survival.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The dual primary endpoints are progression-free survival assessed per RECIST, version 1.1, by blinded independent central review and overall survival

atoms.canonical_statement: Secondary endpoints were objective response, duration of response, and safety.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Secondary end points are objective response and duration of response assessed per RECIST, version 1.1, by blinded independent central review and safety

concept.text: Objective response, duration of response, and safety

atoms.canonical_statement: Efficacy analyses used all randomly allocated participants according to assigned treatment, while safety analyses used all treated participants according to treatment received.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Efficacy is assessed in all randomly allocated participants according to the allocated treatment. Safety is assessed in the as-treated population

atoms.canonical_statement: The analysis plan specified three interim analyses plus a final analysis and controlled family-wise one-sided type I error at 0.025.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The full statistical analysis plan specifies the performance of three interim analyses and a final analysis. An extension of the graphical method of Mauer and Bretz is used to control the family-wise type I error rate at a one-sided α=0.025

atoms.canonical_statement: The first interim analysis was planned after the first 260 participants had at least 8.5 months of follow-up, with about 90% power to detect a 25 percentage-point objective-response difference at one-sided alpha 0.002.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the first interim analysis was to be performed when the first 260 participants enrolled had at least 8.5 months of follow-up ... approximately 90% power to detect a difference in objective response of 25 percentage points (73% vs 48%) ... at one-sided α=0.002

atoms.canonical_statement: Objective-response differences used the stratified Miettinen-Nurminen method and duration of response used Kaplan-Meier estimation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The difference in objective response and its 95% CI were calculated using the Miettinen and Nurminen method stratified by the randomization stratification factors ... Duration of response was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method

atoms.canonical_statement: The reported interim analysis used a June 17, 2020 data cutoff.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: All reported data are based on the first interim analysis, which had a data cutoff of June 17, 2020

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol planned approximately 692 participants in the global cohort, randomized 1:1, plus a separate Japan-specific SOX cohort of about 40 participants not included in primary-endpoint analyses.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Approximately 692 participants will be randomized in the Global Cohort in a 1:1 ratio

atoms.canonical_statement: Protocol eligibility required baseline cardiac assessment with LVEF at least 55%; LVEF 50% to 54% could be eligible after sponsor discussion, cardiology consultation, and medical optimization.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 55% ... Participants with EF 50 to 54 may still be eligible with discussion with Sponsor AND after consultation with cardiology AND after being medically optimized

population.label: Protocol eligibility
inclusion_criteria: LVEF at least 55%, or 50-54% with specified review and optimization

atoms.canonical_statement: Protocol eligibility required QTcF no more than 470 ms for males and 480 ms for females.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: QT interval calculated according to the Fridericia method (QTcF) value ≤470 msec for males and ≤480 msec for females

population.label: Protocol eligibility
inclusion_criteria: QTcF ≤470 ms for males and ≤480 ms for females

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded prior systemic therapy for locally advanced unresectable or metastatic gastric or GEJ cancer, while allowing completed neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy if at least 6 months had elapsed without progression.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has had previous therapy for locally advanced unresectable or metastatic gastric/GEJ cancer. Participants may have received prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy as long as it was completed at least 6 months prior to randomization and there was no evidence of progression

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: Prior therapy for advanced/metastatic disease; limited exception for remote neoadjuvant/adjuvant therapy

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded active CNS metastases or carcinomatous meningitis, with an allowance for treated brain metastases that were radiologically and clinically stable under specified conditions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis. Participants with previously treated brain metastases may participate provided they are radiologically stable

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded active CNS metastases or carcinomatous meningitis, with an allowance for treated brain metastases that were radiologically and clinically stable under specified conditions.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment during the previous 2 years, while allowing replacement therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has an active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in past 2 years

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment during the previous 2 years, while allowing replacement therapy.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded immunodeficiency or chronic systemic corticosteroid use above 10 mg prednisone equivalent daily within 7 days before the first trial dose.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency or is receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy (in dosing exceeding 10 mg daily of prednisone equivalent)

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded immunodeficiency or chronic systemic corticosteroid use above 10 mg prednisone equivalent daily within 7 days before the first trial dose.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded a history of noninfectious pneumonitis requiring steroids or current pneumonitis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has a history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis that required steroids or current pneumonitis

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded a history of noninfectious pneumonitis requiring steroids or current pneumonitis.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded active infection requiring systemic therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has an active infection requiring systemic therapy

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded active infection requiring systemic therapy.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded peripheral neuropathy above grade 1.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has peripheral neuropathy > Grade 1

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded peripheral neuropathy above grade 1.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded active or clinically significant cardiac disease, including symptomatic heart failure and specified recent ischemic or rhythm disorders.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has active or clinically significant cardiac disease including

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded active or clinically significant cardiac disease, including symptomatic heart failure and specified recent ischemic or rhythm disorders.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded previous anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or other specified stimulatory or co-inhibitory T-cell receptor therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has received prior therapy with an anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti PD L2 agent

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded previous anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or other specified stimulatory or co-inhibitory T-cell receptor therapy.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol excluded receipt of a live vaccine within 30 days before the first study-treatment dose.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Has received a live vaccine within 30 days prior to the first dose of study treatment

population.label: Protocol exclusion criterion
exclusion_criteria: The protocol excluded receipt of a live vaccine within 30 days before the first study-treatment dose.

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol specified blinded central imaging and RECIST 1.1 for primary efficacy assessment, with local iRECIST available for treatment decisions after apparent progression.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: RECIST 1.1 responses as assessed by BICR will be used as the primary efficacy endpoint ... if the investigator considers the participant has progressed, but elects to implement iRECIST

atoms.canonical_statement: The protocol specified Kaplan-Meier and stratified log-rank/Cox methods for PFS and OS, stratified Miettinen-Nurminen analysis for objective response, and explicit censoring rules.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The treatment difference in PFS will be assessed by the stratified log-rank test. A stratified Cox proportional hazard model

atoms.canonical_statement: The intention-to-treat population included 434 participants, 217 assigned to each group; 433 received at least one study dose.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Of the 434 participants randomly allocated to treatment ... 217 of 217 allocated to the pembrolizumab group and 216 of 217 allocated to the placebo group ... were included in the as-treated population

atoms.canonical_statement: The efficacy population included 264 participants, 133 in the pembrolizumab group and 131 in the placebo group.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The efficacy population included 133 participants in the pembrolizumab group and 131 in the placebo group

atoms.canonical_statement: Median study follow-up was 9.9 months in the intention-to-treat population and 12.0 months in the efficacy population.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The median (range) study follow-up ... was 9.9 months ... in the intention-to-treat population and 12.0 months ... in the efficacy population

atoms.canonical_statement: In the intention-to-treat population, 81.3% of participants were male.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 81.3% of participants were male

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 68.4% had primary tumours in the stomach

atoms.canonical_statement: In the intention-to-treat population, 50.2% had an intestinal histologic subtype.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 50.2% had an intestinal histologic subtype

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 80.6% had HER2 immunohistochemistry 3+ tumours

atoms.canonical_statement: CAPOX was the selected chemotherapy regimen for 86.6% of participants.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The chosen chemotherapy regimen was capecitabine plus oxaliplatin for 86.6% of participants

atoms.canonical_statement: Objective response was 74.4% with pembrolizumab and 51.9% with placebo; the absolute difference was 22.7 percentage points, 95% CI 11.2 to 33.7, P=0.00006.

Adverse events led to death in 3.2% with pembrolizumab and 4.6% with placebo.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that adding pembrolizumab produced a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in objective response compared with trastuzumab plus chemotherapy alone.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: adding pembrolizumab ... results in a statistically significant, clinically meaningful improvement in objective response rate

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors described responses with pembrolizumab as deeper and more durable and the combination safety profile as manageable, with no new safety events identified.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: responses in the pembrolizumab group to be deeper and more durable. The safety profile ... was manageable ... with no new events identified

atoms.canonical_statement: At this first interim analysis, progression-free survival and overall survival, the trial's dual primary endpoints, had not yet been reported.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: results for the primary end points of overall and progression-free survival will be assessed at a later date

atoms.canonical_statement: The interim efficacy analysis was limited to the first 264 randomized participants and focused on objective response.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: first interim analysis of objective response rate for the first 264 participants enrolled

atoms.canonical_statement: Biomarker analyses reported to date were limited to MSI-high status and PD-L1 expression.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: To-date, the only biomarkers we have explored are MSI-high status and PD-L1 expression

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors suggested that pembrolizumab, trastuzumab, and chemotherapy could become a treatment option and supported study in earlier-stage disease.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: may be a transformative treatment option ... and support exploring the combination in patients with earlier stages of disease
